packages.name: ComfyUI Image Editing
packages.description: Edit and transform images using any ComfyUI img2img workflow. Provide a reference image and describe the changes — the package uploads the image, injects it into the LoadImage node, and returns the edited result. Great for style transfer, recolouring, and iterative refinement.

packages.name: Currency Exchange Rates
packages.description: Fetch live and historical exchange rates between any two currencies. Get USD vs EUR/GBP/JPY/BRL (and more), convert amounts, compare a base currency against many targets at once, and look up rates on any past date back to 1999. Powered by the free Frankfurter API (ECB data) — no API key required.

packages.name: Rich Responses
packages.description: Generate charts, tables, and visual cards inline in chat. Provides line/bar/pie charts (SVG, offline), metric cards, comparison grids, and styled data tables — no configuration needed.

packages.name: PDF Tools
packages.description: Read and generate PDF files completely offline. Extract text, tables, and metadata from any PDF; create styled documents and multi-section reports with tables. No internet required.

packages.name: LaTeX PDF
packages.description: Generate beautifully typeset PDFs with complex math equations, Greek symbols, matrices, integrals, and scientific notation. Compiles real LaTeX via Tectonic (recommended — a single standalone engine binary that auto-downloads packages on demand) or a classic TeX distribution (pdflatex / xelatex / lualatex from TeX Live / MiKTeX). ZERO-CONFIG: when no engine is on PATH, Tectonic is automatically downloaded to a per-user cache (~50 MB, one-time) on the first compile call — no manual install required. Disable the auto-download with the 'No auto-install' option for offline / restricted environments.

args_schema.name: engine
args_schema.label: LaTeX Engine (auto | tectonic | pdflatex | xelatex | lualatex)

packages.name: Iterative Image Refiner
packages.description: Self-contained iterative image refinement: generate an image, visually inspect it against a 10-category artifact checklist, score it, and edit to fix issues — repeating until quality passes. Connects directly to ComfyUI for generation and editing.

packages.name: Blender MCP
packages.description: Connect to Blender 3D through the BlenderMCP addon. Create, modify, and delete 3D objects, apply materials, execute Python code, capture viewport screenshots, and access Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D Rodin, and Hunyuan3D asset libraries - all from the chat window. Requires the BlenderMCP addon running in Blender with 'Connect to Claude' enabled.
